SCRIPT
 import plotly.graph_objects as go
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots
import pandas as pd

data = {
    'Stage': [
        'Needs Assessment', 'Feasibility Study', 'Funding Secured',
        'Pilot Implementation', 'Full Implementation', 'Monitoring',
        'Mid-Term Evaluation', 'Impact Analysis', 'Sustainability Review',
        'Scaling Phase', 'Legacy Assessment', 'Post-Project Review'
    ],
    'Projects_Progress': [90, 85, 80, 75, 70, 65, 60, 55, 50, 45, 40, 35],
    'Funding_Utilized': [3200, 4800, 7000, 8500, 9200, 8800, 8300, 7800, 7200, 6500, 5800, 5200],
    'Success_Rate': [0.92, 0.90, 0.88, 0.86, 0.84, 0.82, 0.80, 0.79, 0.78, 0.76, 0.74, 0.72],
    'Impact_Score': [32, 48, 65, 72, 80, 83, 86, 90, 88, 85, 82, 78],
    'Region': [
        'Global', 'Global', 'Sub-Saharan Africa', 'Sub-Saharan Africa',
        'Sub-Saharan Africa & Asia', 'Asia & Latin America',
        'Latin America', 'Latin America', 'Latin America & MENA',
        'MENA & Southeast Asia', 'Southeast Asia', 'Global'
    ],
    'Risk_Level': [0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 0.4, 0.45, 0.5, 0.55, 0.6, 0.58, 0.52, 0.48, 0.4]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

fig = make_subplots(
    rows=3, cols=1,
    shared_xaxes=True,
    vertical_spacing=0.08,
    subplot_titles=(
        "Project Progress & Success Rate Across Stages",
        "Funding Utilized & Impact Score by Stage",
        "Risk Level During Project Lifecycle"
    )
)

fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=df['Stage'],
        y=df['Success_Rate'],
        name="Projects Progress (%)",
        mode='lines+markers',
        marker=dict(color='#1f77b4', size=8),
        line=dict(color='#1f77b4', width=2),
        showlegend=True
    ),
    row=1, col=1
)

fig.add_trace(
    go.Bar(
        x=df['Stage'],
        y=df['Projects_Progress'],
        name="Success Rate",
        marker_color='#2ca02c',
        opacity=0.8,
        showlegend=True
    ),
    row=1, col=1
)

fig.add_trace(
    go.Bar(
        x=df['Stage'],
        y=df['Funding_Utilized'],
        name="Funding Utilized ($M)",
        marker_color='#2ca02c',
        opacity=0.8,
        showlegend=True
    ),
    row=2, col=1
)

fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=df['Stage'],
        y=df['Impact_Score'],
        name="Impact Score",
        mode='lines+markers',
        marker=dict(color='#d62728', size=8),
        line=dict(color='#d62728', width=2),
        showlegend=True
    ),
    row=2, col=1
)

fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=df['Stage'],
        y=df['Risk_Level'],
        name="Risk Level",
        mode='lines+markers',
        marker=dict(color='#9467bd', size=8),
        line=dict(color='#9467bd', width=2, dash='dash'),
        showlegend=True
    ),
    row=3, col=1
)

fig.update_layout(
    height=900,
    width=1000,
    title_text="Global Economic Growth Trends by Quarter",
    template='plotly_white',
    legend=dict(
        orientation="h",
        yanchor="bottom",
        y=1.02,
        xanchor="right",
        x=1
    ),
    hovermode='x unified'
)

fig.update_xaxes(tickangle=45, tickfont=dict(size=10))
fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Success Rate / Projects Progress (%)", row=1, col=1)
fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Funding ($M) / Impact Score", row=2, col=1)
fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Risk Level", row=3, col=1)

for i in range(1, 4):
    fig.update_yaxes(showgrid=True, gridwidth=1, gridcolor='LightGray', row=i, col=1)

fig.write_image("output.png")
SUMMARY
 This image presents a **Comprehensive Development Project Dashboard by Stage**, consisting of three vertically stacked subplots that analyze different aspects of a project's lifecycle through various metrics. Each subplot is clearly labeled with its respective focus, and the stages of the project are displayed along the horizontal axis, ranging from "Needs Assessment" to "Post-Project Review."

The **first subplot**, titled *"Project Progress & Success Rate Across Stages,"* features a combination of bar and line charts. The bars, colored in a warm orange hue, represent the **Projects Progress (%)** at each stage, starting at 90% during the "Needs Assessment" phase and gradually declining to 35% by the "Post-Project Review." The y-axis on the left measures this progress in percentages. Overlaid on this is a blue line with markers, depicting the **Success Rate**, which remains relatively high and stable, beginning at 0.92 (or 92%) and slightly decreasing to 0.72 (72%) by the final stage. The y-axis on the right corresponds to the success rate, though the values are scaled to align closely with the project progress percentages.

The **second subplot**, titled *"Funding Utilized & Impact Score by Stage,"* also employs a combination of bar and line charts. The green bars reflect the **Funding Utilized ($M)**, with funding peaking during the "Full Implementation" stage at $9,200 million before gradually tapering off to $5,200 million by the "Post-Project Review." The left y-axis measures funding in millions of dollars. A red line with markers illustrates the **Impact Score**, starting at 32 during the "Needs Assessment" phase and rising steadily, reaching its highest point of 90 during the "Impact Analysis" stage before slightly declining to 78 by the end of the project lifecycle. The right y-axis represents the impact score.

The **third and final subplot**, titled *"Risk Level During Project Lifecycle,"* displays a single purple dashed line with markers, representing the **Risk Level** as it fluctuates across the project stages. The risk begins relatively low at 0.2 during the "Needs Assessment" phase, increases steadily to a peak of 0.6 during the "Impact Analysis" stage, and then declines to 0.4 by the "Post-Project Review." The y-axis measures the risk level on a scale from 0 to 1.

The overall layout ensures clarity and ease of comparison, with each subplot maintaining consistent x-axis labels for the project stages. The chart employs a clean, professional color scheme and includes a unified legend at the top, which clearly identifies each data series. Grid lines are present in each subplot to aid in the precise interpretation of values.

p = Path("chart.py")
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('name="Projects Progress (%)"', 'name="__SWAP__"')
s = s.replace('name="Success Rate"', 'name="Projects Progress (%)"')
s = s.replace('name="__SWAP__"', 'name="Success Rate"')
s = s.replace("y=df['Projects_Progress'],\n        name=\"Projects Progress (%)\",\n        marker_color='#2ca02c'", "y=df['Projects_Progress'],\n        name=\"Projects Progress (%)\",\n        marker_color='#ff7f0e'")
s = s.replace('title_text="Global Economic Growth Trends by Quarter"', 'title_text="Comprehensive Development Project Dashboard by Stage"')
p.write_text(s)
exec(compile(s, "chart.py", "exec"))
print("Title:", fig.layout.title.text)
for trace in fig.data:
    print(trace.name, "color:", trace.marker.color, "values:", list(trace.y))
table = pd.read_csv("table.csv")
for trace, column in zip(fig.data, ["Success_Rate", "Projects_Progress", "Funding_Utilized", "Impact_Score", "Risk_Level"]):
    assert list(trace.y) == table[column].tolist()
assert fig.data[1].marker.color == '#ff7f0e'
assert fig.data[0].name == "Success Rate"
assert fig.data[1].name == "Projects Progress (%)"
assert fig.layout.title.text == "Comprehensive Development Project Dashboard by Stage"
